title: The Box Boat
description: A box, a toy, and room for us all.

intro.alt: A box, a toy, and room for us all.

notice: A make-believe family adventure with Anna, Sarah and one-year-old Leah. Read and choose, or listen together.
script:
story 2
variable bear = false hidden
scene family-box-boat
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Leah curious center
camera wide cut
I: Mum made a box boat. Leah sits by Mum.
Anna [happy]: Let us sail on the rug!
Sarah [curious]: A toy can come, too.
choice toy
option bear "Take the bear." -> bear ; bear = true
option pup "Take the pup." -> pup
label bear
Sarah [happy]: A bear on a boat!
goto room
label pup
Sarah [happy]: A pup on a boat!
goto room
label room
Anna [worried]: Oh! No room for us all.
express Leah sad
I: Leah pats the box.
choice space
option rug "Sit on the rug." -> rug
option toy "Move the toy." -> move
label rug
react Anna crouch
Anna [happy]: The rug is our boat, too!
goto join
label move
react Sarah point
Sarah [happy]: The toy can sit by the box.
goto join
label join
camera listener Leah cut
I: Mum helps Leah join us. She pats our boat.
Anna [happy]: Room for you, Leah!
camera wide cut
choice trip
option sea "Go to sea." -> sea
option home "Go back home." -> home
label sea
Sarah [happy]: A big fish! Wave to it!
goto endtoy
label home
Sarah [happy]: Home! Time for a cup of tea!
goto endtoy
label endtoy
if bear == true -> bearend else pupend
label bearend
Anna [happy]: Our bear had a big day.
goto done
label pupend
Anna [happy]: Our pup had a big day.
goto done
label done
I: Leah pats the rug. One more trip?
end

Anna.name: Anna

Sarah.name: Sarah
Sarah.provenance: Family-inspired storybook character styling, guided by David’s supplied family watercolor; original animated illustration.

Leah.name: Leah
